Hi Sophie / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday — great convo and appreciate the clarity on your latency and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope: pilot (10k requests/mo) for clinician-facing summarization + embeddings for search.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 400ms, average cost < $0.003/token for summaries, and no PHI logged to hosted model.
- Security asks: SOC2 evidence + audit log retention options — I attached the vendor portal instructions so procurement knows what to expect.

Nearest next steps:
1) I’ll send a purchase order template + SOW draft to your procurement.
2) Procurement to complete vendor setup in our portal (W-9 + ACH if paying via bank).
3) Once portal is active, we can enable a dedicated trial pool and run a short perf sweep.

If procurement prefers, Marcus (cc’d) can guide the portal step and Laura can help on contract redlines. Can you confirm who on your side is handling vendor setup and an expected timing window?

Thanks — I’ll hold next Tuesday 10–12 PT for a quick check if that helps.

Best,
Tessa
